description: Search the data map's library of DMIRS Data and Software Centre (DASC) open-file datasets for Western Australia (about 600: geology, geophysics compilations, mineralisation, WAROX field data, heritage, land, infrastructure, ...) and its 1:250 000 / 1:100 000 geological map sheets. Every word of q must appear in the title or category. Returns each dataset's title, group, category, last update, feature count and layer ids ("lib:...") for library_features and map_link.
name: search_library
title: Search the DMIRS data library
